gen-dafont-stencilia-gf-fauna-one: Structural and striking, with gaps left at every curve's end. Stencilia is built for making a statement, while Fauna One is built for quiet, dignified reading with a tall middle band.
gen-dafont-stencilia-gf-glegoo: Sharp and structural up top, Stencilia leaves generous gaps at its curve ends, while Glegoo below is refined and editorial. Glegoo's big open counters leave the headline plenty of space to land.
gen-dafont-stencilia-gf-kadwa: Striking, structural Stencilia leaves spacious gaps where each curve ends, built to turn heads. Kadwa, meanwhile, does the quieter work, with open-ended curves and a larger-than-usual x-height made for steady reading.
gen-dafont-stencilia-gf-noticia-text: Stencilia strikes a structural pose, with spacious gaps at its curve terminals, over Noticia Text in a literary, dignified voice. The two feel like a loud entrance and a quiet room.
gen-dafont-stencilia-gf-scope-one: Spacious gaps at the curve terminals mark Stencilia, while Scope One lets its counters spill into the surrounding space. Stencilia earns its keep when it is big and short.
gen-dafont-stencilia-gf-slabo-13px: Structural and striking, with spacious gaps at every curve end. Shrink Stencilia and those gaps lose their drama, while Slabo 13px offers rounded letters with clear openings and large counters.
gen-dafont-stentiga-gf-piazzolla: Opened-up tracking gives Stentiga a spread-out, luxurious look, with letter openings like a door left ajar. But Piazzolla carries a paragraph with authority, its lowercase nearly matching the capitals.
gen-dafont-stentiga-gf-scope-one: Luxurious and spread out, Stentiga has zero stroke contrast, every line uniform throughout. Scope One lets counters spill into the surrounding space, so extended text feels traditional and refined.
gen-dafont-stentiga-gf-slabo-13px: Luxurious and spaced-out, Stentiga holds every line at zero stroke modulation. Slabo 13px settles into a bookish, dignified rhythm, its large counters in tall letters keeping paragraph after paragraph inviting.
gen-dafont-true-north-fs-asap: Stocky and contemporary, True North stands on a middle band so tall its curves refuse to close. Asap does the reading work, its c forms open arcs and its body height nearly matching the capitals.
